scope: escrow, refunds, prizes, owner accounting, and profiles
session registration, expiry, rotation, and revocation
ERC-4337 account validation and replay resistance
paymaster target, selector, value, sender, factory, and gas policy

findings.title: PlayerRegistry accepted result calls from unrecognized contracts spoofing an authorized factory
findings.resolution: Require caller == supplied instance and require the authorized factory to attest isInstance(instance).
regressionTests: test/factory/PlayerProfile.test.js: ignores result writes from a contract spoofing an authorized parent factory

findings.title: Factory profile and owner-share callbacks were callable by arbitrary addresses
findings.resolution: Restrict registerPlayer and receiveOwnerShare to factory-created instances and validate enrollment provenance in PlayerRegistry.
regressionTests: test/factory/PlayerProfile.test.js: rejects direct factory profile registration from non-instances
test/factory/PlayerProfile.test.js: rejects owner-share lifecycle calls from non-instances
test/factory/PlayerProfile.test.js: requires authorized factories to attest enrollment instance provenance

findings.title: A valid session can submit policy-compliant moves that revert and consume sponsored gas
findings.rationale: Reverting gameplay cannot affect escrow or identity, but can consume the isolated paymaster budget. The release requires a capped deposit, emergency pause, spend alerts, provider rate limits, and direct-primary fallback.

findings.title: Protocol administration retains deployment, factory authorization, paymaster pause, and post-conclusion rescue powers
findings.rationale: These powers cannot authorize session gameplay or redirect an active tournament pot. Production ownership must use the recorded multisig roles and every action must be monitored.
